title: Sign-in page appearance
cardDesc: Sign-in, password change and Passkey pages of web authentication
styleHelp: A site can use a different style in its web authentication settings; the branding and custom CSS below apply to every style.
colorHelp: Replaces the accent color of buttons, focus rings and icons. Leave empty to use the style's own color.
backgroundHelp: Enter an image URL or upload an image (compressed automatically). Leave empty to use the style's own background.
logoPlaceholder: Image URL (http/https), or upload an image
logoHelp: Replaces the lock icon on the sign-in page. A square PNG or SVG with a transparent background works best.
logoTooLarge: The logo cannot exceed {size}. Compress it before uploading, or use an image URL instead
subtitle: Description
subtitlePlaceholder: This site is protected. Please verify your identity first
textHelp: The title and description are shown as entered and are not translated for visitors; leave them empty to use the default text in the visitor's language.
hideBrandHelp: Removes the Gately mark from the footer; the domain being visited is still shown.
cssHelp: Appended after the selected style, up to {size}. "<" is escaped, so no tags can be inserted. Available class names:
previewHelp: The preview uses a sample domain and user and runs no scripts. After saving, it applies at once to every site with web authentication.
siteOverrides: {count} site(s) use their own style and do not follow the style chosen here.
siteStyleHelp: The style used by the sign-in, password change and Passkey pages. Branding such as the accent color, background image and logo, and custom CSS, are set in the global appearance and apply to every style.
